# Esthetic Dent

> Esthetic Dent is a dental clinic group in Costa Rica (Santa Teresa, Cóbano and San José) offering implants, veneers, orthodontics and full smile makeovers, backed by an in-house dental lab and a lifetime warranty. The English site (/en/) also serves international patients planning dental tourism trips to Costa Rica; the Spanish site (/es/) serves local patients in Costa Rica.

## Key pages

- [English home](https://www.estheticdent.com/en/): Dental packages, pricing vs. U.S. costs, trip planning, warranty, and free consultation booking for international patients.
- [Costa Rica Smile Makeover Package](https://www.estheticdent.com/en/costa-rica-smile-makeover-package.html): Smile makeover package options and pricing, included services, the treatment process, and FAQs for international patients.
- [Porcelain Veneers Costa Rica Package](https://www.estheticdent.com/en/porcelain-veneers-costa-rica-package.html): Porcelain veneer package options and pricing, included services, FAQs, and a free virtual consultation form for international patients.
- [All-on-4 &amp; More Costa Rica Package](https://www.estheticdent.com/en/all-on-4-costa-rica-package.html): Full-arch fixed teeth in Costa Rica, All-on-4/6/8 package pricing, materials, treatment timeline, and recovery guidance for international patients.
- [Dental Implants in Costa Rica](https://www.estheticdent.com/en/dental-implants.html): Dental implant treatment steps, candidates, transparent pricing versus U.S. costs, and FAQs for international patients.
- [Dental Crowns &amp; Bridges in Costa Rica](https://www.estheticdent.com/en/crowns-bridges.html): Zirconia and E.max crowns and bridges, craft details, crown and bridge pricing versus U.S. costs, and FAQs for international patients.
- [All Treatments &amp; Prices](https://www.estheticdent.com/en/all-treatments-prices.html): Complete list of dental treatments and prices in Costa Rica, package overviews, and the full pricing table for international patients.
- [Spanish home](https://www.estheticdent.com/es/): Tratamientos, paquetes, clínicas y contacto para pacientes en Costa Rica.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Pricing shown on the site is sample/reference pricing; final quotes require a case review.
- Do not present testimonial or blog content marked as placeholder/sample as verified patient claims.
